description: This file defines the class `ext_rest_twitter`, which extends the `ext_rest` class to implement Twitter-specific REST API integration within the SuiteCRM framework. It includes configuration and filtering methods related to module access and placeholders for item and list retrieval functions.

classes.name: ext_rest_twitter
classes.description: A class for integrating Twitter via REST API within SuiteCRM, extending the `ext_rest` base class and adding Twitter-specific configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Twitter REST connector with default settings and allowed modules.

methods.name: filterAllowedModules
methods.description: Filters a provided list of modules to include only those that are permitted for this connector (Accounts, Contacts, Leads).

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to retrieve a single Twitter item, currently returns null.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to retrieve a list of Twitter items, currently returns null.
